title: I Will Tear You To Pieces
blurb: A threat that lands somewhere between genuinely alarming and completely ridiculous, which is the exact register The Amazing Digital Circus lives in. The show keeps dropping cartoon characters into situations with real stakes and then letting them react like cartoons anyway, and four seconds of this is a neat sample of the effect. Fans use it in edits, gaming clips and Discord servers as the maximum-drama way of expressing mild annoyance. Strongly recommended for lobby chat, ranked matches, and anyone taking a board game too seriously.
origin: A line from The Amazing Digital Circus (Glitch Productions).
